Risk Description: Administrator account compromise due to incomplete MFA coverage
Existing Control: MFA is enabled for some administrative accounts
Control Gap: MFA is not enforced for all administrators
Recommended Remediation: Require MFA for all administrator and remote access accounts

Control Gap: Retention periods are not consistently reviewed
Recommended Remediation: Define retention periods and securely delete cardholder data when no longer required

Control Gap: Some critical findings exceed remediation timelines
Recommended Remediation: Define severity-based remediation SLAs and require risk acceptance for exceptions

Risk Description: Unauthorized access caused by excessive permissions
Recommended Remediation: Perform quarterly access reviews and remove unnecessary permissions

Risk Description: Delayed detection of suspicious payment-system activity
Control Gap: Daily log review evidence is incomplete
Recommended Remediation: Document daily security log reviews and retain investigation records

Risk Description: Incident response failure during payment-card breach
Control Gap: Plan has not been recently tested
Recommended Remediation: Conduct annual tabletop exercises and document corrective actions

Risk Description: Undetected security weaknesses due to inconsistent penetration testing
Control Gap: Penetration testing is not consistently scheduled
Recommended Remediation: Perform annual penetration testing and test after significant changes
Perform annual security reassessments of critical service providers

Risk Description: Unauthorized network access due to outdated firewall rules
Recommended Remediation: Perform quarterly firewall rule reviews and document approvals

Risk Description: Insufficient assurance over physical protection of hosted systems
Control Gap: Physical security attestations have not been formally reviewed
Recommended Remediation: Review cloud provider compliance reports and physical security attestations
